reviews.text: A competent, professional, and very welcoming team. I highly recommend this clinic.
Adorable team

No assistance or empathy whatsoever. It's deplorable. We booked an appointment over a month in advance for a trip with our dog, only to be told on the day of our appointment that it was canceled. No help whatsoever, no way to reschedule with someone else. All this for a visit lasting just a few minutes. We won't be going back. This lack of professionalism is disappointing.

Since the response doesn't address my feeling of being neglected, I'll elaborate a bit more:

Upon returning from vacation, our 11-year-old rabbit had bleeding from her chest. As it was a Sunday, we went to an open veterinary clinic for an emergency visit. The doctor advised us to contact our regular vet quickly after providing initial care, which included examining our rabbit, shaving around the area of ​​the lump, and applying saline solution to clean the wound.
So, on Monday, we called our regular vet because our rabbit had already had surgery there. There were no appointments available until Thursday, but we weren't available then (my wife is pregnant, and we had a midwife appointment). Therefore, the next available appointment is in 10 days. I took care to describe the symptoms precisely, which strongly suggested the need for urgent surgery, and no one bothered to tell us that the clinic wouldn't be able to perform the necessary procedure. During the appointment, the vet was professional, but the appointment was unnecessary, and our rabbit simply received the same treatment already given by the first vet, treatment we've also been providing at home for the past two weeks.

It seems to me that this appointment should never have taken place and that the receptionist should have immediately told us to make an appointment elsewhere instead of keeping us on this appointment and charging us €40 for nothing.

€40 just to tell us to go see another vet... The clinic is understaffed and can't operate on our rabbit.
The symptoms were described before our visit; we could have saved a week...

We were very disappointed with our visit to this veterinary clinic. The young, dark-haired veterinarian who saw us displayed a blatant lack of empathy and professionalism. Her cold attitude and lack of attentiveness left us feeling misunderstood, especially since we were worried about our pet. We expected more consideration and support. This experience was very disappointing, and we will not be returning to this clinic.

The end of our pets' lives is such a sensitive subject and an intense ordeal. I took my beloved Gribouille for her final visit to the vet, and I wanted to express my gratitude for Dr. Girodengo's exceptional kindness. She understood my distress and did everything she could to make this moment as compassionate as possible. Thank you.

Avoid at all costs. Absolutely no empathy. I brought my dog ​​in on April 7th for a cortisone injection to relieve his arthritis in one leg, and Dr. Agnès Amghar injected him with a different product that caused spasms and a lot of whimpering for hours. My dog ​​was in great pain, and Dr. Amghar refused to see him, claiming her schedule was full, and told me to go elsewhere, even though my dog ​​was howling in pain and there was no one else in the waiting room. He was euthanized at another clinic to end his suffering on April 8th, 2026.

Extremely disappointed.

After calling this clinic last night about my dog ​​Kiara, who has lymphoma, I had to insist to get an appointment for tomorrow morning.

Finally, I received a voicemail from the receptionist informing me that the veterinarian refused to treat my dog ​​because the clinic wasn't specialized in oncology and therefore couldn't write a prescription. However, it's not necessary to be an oncology specialist to treat an animal with cancer and prescribe chemotherapy.

This refusal is all the more incomprehensible given that a friend confirmed that his cat has been treated at this same clinic for cancer for several years and has been receiving chemotherapy there for a long time.

In such a serious situation, one expects at least some understanding and compassion. Instead, I felt a profound sense of abandonment, especially since I had clearly stated that I didn't have the financial means to turn to a specialized organization. When you want to care for animals, you must show empathy and respect. This is clearly not the case here, as it seems that animals are cared for based on personal feelings and money.

They didn't accept the cat for an appointment, despite the fact that the cat had lost half its weight in a short period of time and had a large wound on its neck.
From the initial phone call to the service itself: perfect! I highly recommend them! Clear quotes and explanations. Professional and friendly staff.
A very warm welcome and excellent support during difficult times, thank you!

For over three years, this clinic has cared for my cat with exceptional guidance and kindness each time. I always felt, with every visit, that my cat was as important to them as it was to me.

Unfortunately, I had to have her euthanized yesterday due to a sudden and aggressive cancer, and once again, I received remarkable support from everyone at the clinic.
I highly recommend them; the respect and consideration they show is truly remarkable.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything.
Very friendly vet

Last-minute cancellation without notification

My appointment was simply canceled without any prior notice. I arrived at the clinic at the scheduled time, only to be told at reception that my appointment had been canceled.

The staff assured me that an email and a phone call had been made to inform me. However, I received no communication whatsoever: no email in my inbox (not even in spam), no missed calls, and no voicemail on my phone.

While a cancellation is sometimes unavoidable, the bare minimum is to inform the patient properly. This negligence wasted my time and caused me obvious inconvenience.

I strongly advise against using this clinic if you require reliable service.

€130 - My dog ​​barely touched - a complete rip-off

Our dog has wounds and a rather strong odor of unknown origin.

He's stressed at the vet's, but calms down very quickly in our presence.
The appointment lasted about fifteen minutes, during which they performed the standard examinations (listening to his heart, palpating his abdomen, etc.), but they barely looked at his wounds and didn't even try to find the source of the odor, which is why we came in the first place.
I know very well that we'll have to go back to the vet, but it will definitely not be to this clinic.

I've been taking my cats to them for four years now, and their system is so well-organized. When you have an emergency, the receptionists do everything they can to give you an appointment, either the same day or the next. I think it's fantastic that they reserve those slots for emergencies (though I don't know if it's intentional or if I've just been lucky each time), but I think it's excellent, as it saves you from ending up in the emergency room with overworked vets. The advice they give over the phone or during consultations is so reassuring that you feel like your pet is already cured. And what I appreciate most is that if they can avoid a consultation, they do so by telling you what to do for your pet.
Honestly, I have no complaints. Yes, I have lost some cats that I couldn't save despite treatment, but I'm aware that they aren't superhuman.
